name: scrcpy-mcp
description: MCP server for Android device control via ADB and scrcpy — gives AI agents vision and control over Android devices

tools.name: app_current
tools.description: Get the currently foregrounded app package name and activity.

tools.name: app_install
tools.description: Install an APK file on the device from the host machine.

tools.name: app_list
tools.description: List installed packages on the device. Optionally filter by name or restrict to system/third-party apps.

tools.name: app_start
tools.description: Launch an app on the device. Uses scrcpy START_APP when a session is active for faster launch, falls back to ADB `am start`. Supports force-stop prefix (+) to stop the app before launching.

tools.name: app_stop
tools.description: Force-stop an app on the device.

tools.name: app_uninstall
tools.description: Uninstall an app from the device.

tools.name: clipboard_get
tools.description: Get the current clipboard content from the device. Uses scrcpy GET_CLIPBOARD when a session is active (works on Android 10+), falls back to ADB clipboard commands.

tools.name: clipboard_set
tools.description: Set the clipboard content on the device. Uses scrcpy SET_CLIPBOARD when a session is active (with optional paste flag), falls back to ADB clipboard commands.

tools.name: collapse_panels
tools.description: Collapse all open panels (notification, settings) (requires active scrcpy session)

tools.name: connect_wifi
tools.description: Enable WiFi ADB and connect to the device wirelessly. Returns the connection address.

tools.name: device_info
tools.description: Get detailed info about a device: model, Android version, screen size, SDK level, battery level

tools.name: device_list
tools.description: List all connected Android devices with their serial numbers, state, and model

tools.name: disconnect_wifi
tools.description: Disconnect from a wireless ADB device

tools.name: drag_drop
tools.description: Perform a drag and drop gesture from one point to another. Uses input draganddrop on Android 8.0+ (API 26), falls back to swipe on older versions.

tools.name: expand_notifications
tools.description: Expand the notification panel (requires active scrcpy session)

tools.name: expand_settings
tools.description: Expand the quick settings panel (requires active scrcpy session)

tools.name: file_list
tools.description: List directory contents on the device.

tools.name: file_pull
tools.description: Pull a file from the device to the host machine.

tools.name: file_push
tools.description: Push a file from the host machine to the device.

tools.name: input_text
tools.description: Type text into the currently focused input field

tools.name: key_event
tools.description: Send a key event to the device. Supports keycodes like HOME, BACK, ENTER, VOLUME_UP, etc.

tools.name: long_press
tools.description: Perform a long press at the specified coordinates

tools.name: rotate_device
tools.description: Rotate the device screen (requires active scrcpy session)

tools.name: screen_off
tools.description: Turn the device screen off

tools.name: screen_on
tools.description: Wake the device screen (turn screen on)

tools.name: screen_record_start
tools.description: Start recording the screen. Recording continues until screen_record_stop is called.

tools.name: screen_record_stop
tools.description: Stop screen recording and optionally pull the file to the host.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the Android device screen. Returns the image as base64.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll at the specified position. dx and dy are scroll amounts (-1 to 1 range approximated for ADB).

tools.name: shell_exec
tools.description: Execute an arbitrary ADB shell command on the device and return the output. Use this for any device operation not covered by other tools.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a scrcpy session for fast input control and screenshots. When a session is active, tap/swipe/text/screenshot are 10-50x faster. Requires scrcpy-server to be installed.

tools.name: start_video_stream
tools.description: Start an HTTP MJPEG video stream of the device screen. Opens a native ffplay window that connects to the stream URL. Requires an active scrcpy session.

tools.name: stop_session
tools.description: Stop the active scrcpy session. Tools will fall back to ADB commands.

tools.name: stop_video_stream
tools.description: Stop the HTTP MJPEG video stream and close the viewer window for a device.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Perform a swipe gesture from one point to another

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap at the specified screen coordinates

tools.name: ui_dump
tools.description: Dump the full UI hierarchy of the current screen as XML. Useful for understanding screen structure before using ui_find_element.

tools.name: ui_find_element
tools.description: Find UI elements on screen by text, resource ID, class name, or content description. Returns matching elements with their tap coordinates. At least one search criterion must be provided.

ADB_PATH.title: Path to ADB Binary
ADB_PATH.description: Path to ADB binary (optional, default: adb)

ANDROID_SERIAL.title: Android Serial Number
ANDROID_SERIAL.description: Device serial number (optional, for multiple devices)

FFMPEG_PATH.title: Path to FFmpeg Binary
FFMPEG_PATH.description: Path to ffmpeg binary (optional, default: ffmpeg)

FFPLAY_PATH.title: Path to FFplay Binary
FFPLAY_PATH.description: Path to ffplay binary (optional, default: ffplay)
